items.title: Apple's all-new AirPods 5 bring ANC to an open-ear design for $129
items.summary: Apple announced AirPods 5 on September 9 with an all-new multiport acoustic architecture that removes up to 50 percent more external noise than AirPods 4 with ANC. The open-ear earbuds add next-generation Adaptive EQ, Live Translation, hands-free Siri AI and improved dust, sweat and water resistance, priced from $129, or $149 with a wireless charging case and on-stem volume control. They went on sale on September 18.

items.title: Bose expands open-ear line with Sport Open Earbuds and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen)
items.summary: Bose unveiled the Sport Open Earbuds at $199 and the Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $299 on September 17, both built on Bose OpenAudio technology and SpeechClarity AI voice isolation. The flagship Ultra Open adds deeper bass, Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial and up to 9 hours of playback, with pre-orders opening September 19 ahead of an October 1 launch.

items.title: Open-ear earbuds are booming while traditional TWS stalls, Omdia says
items.summary: Omdia data shows open-ear audio growing rapidly while sealed TWS growth flattens, with Bose, Shokz, Sony and CMF all pushing new clip and cuff designs. Sony's $229.99 LinkBuds Clip and the $99 CMF Clip Pro bookend the category, and Omdia expects vendors to add more fitness, commuting and AI features as they chase the segment.

items.title: Sennheiser MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 ships with user-replaceable batteries
items.summary: Sennheiser's flagship MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 arrived with user-replaceable batteries in both the earbuds and the case, Bluetooth 6.0 with aptX Lossless up to 24-bit/96kHz, Dolby Atmos head tracking and up to 40 hours of total playback. Priced at $299.95 in the US to match the previous generation, it began shipping on September 3 in five metallic colours.

items.title: Oppo Enco X4 goes global with AI translation and Dynaudio tuning
items.summary: Oppo launched the Enco X4 true wireless earbuds globally on September 22, featuring a coaxial dual-driver system co-developed with Dynaudio, a 6nm chip with AI noise cancellation, lossless transmission claimed up to 400 percent faster than the previous generation, and AI-powered real-time translation. Each earbud weighs just 5.6g with IP55 dust and water protection.

items.title: TOZO NC9 Pro adds a 1.47-inch touchscreen charging case
items.summary: TOZO launched the NC9 Pro earbuds on September 15 with a 1.47-inch smart touchscreen case that doubles as a control centre, plus LDAC and Hi-Res Audio Wireless, a 10mm SDLC dynamic driver, EarTune hearing optimisation and a set of TOZO AI features. Bluetooth 6.0 multipoint, IPX8 protection and a low-latency gaming mode round out the package.

items.title: HIFIMAN Svanar Wireless 2 brings R-2R DAC architecture to TWS at $299
items.summary: HIFIMAN introduced the Svanar Wireless 2 reference true wireless earbud at $299, built around the company's new HYMALAYA Mini DAC chip that condenses its R-2R architecture into a single tiny component. Each earbud weighs 7.4g and offers Bluetooth 6.0 with L2HC and LDAC streaming, ANC rated up to -35dB and an independent Class AB balanced amplifier.

items.title: Vivo and iQOO launch budget TWS earbuds in India from Rs 1,899
items.summary: Vivo and iQOO launched budget true wireless earbuds in India at Rs 1,999 and Rs 1,899 respectively. Vivo Buds claim up to 50 hours of battery life with AI call noise cancellation and multiple sound modes, while iQOO Buds add Bluetooth 6.1 dual-device connection, IP54 water resistance and app-based customisation for everyday music, calls and fitness use.

items.title: Nothing Ear (3a) updated with 32MB storage and 12mm drivers for $99
items.summary: Nothing refreshed its $99 Ear (3a) earbuds with 32MB of built-in storage that records calls at the pinch of your fingers before syncing to the Nothing X app, plus upgraded 12mm drivers for fuller hi-res audio. A new pink colourway joins the existing black, white and yellow options.

items.title: Lab tests show earbud ANC quality depends on the mic array, not the price
items.summary: SoundGuys' updated 2026 lab testing found the Apple AirPods Pro 3 leading average noise reduction at 90 percent, while the $69 CMF Buds 2 Plus reached 83 percent, matching the $249.99 Powerbeats Pro 2. It argues buyers should compare average attenuation across all frequencies rather than peak decibel claims measured at one favourable point.

items.title: LE Audio reaches 41% of new TWS shipments, but Auracast usage lags at 8%
items.summary: ABI Research data cited in a new Bluetooth headset market study shows LE Audio adoption reached 41 percent of global new consumer TWS shipments in 2025, yet real-world Auracast broadcast usage stayed below 8 percent. Measured Auracast multi-device latency averaged 45 to 70 milliseconds in congested 2.4GHz environments.

items.title: TWS earbuds generate $14.1B as Bluetooth headphone revenue tops $22B
items.summary: A new Bluetooth devices market report values Bluetooth headphones at $22.02 billion in 2025, about 38 percent of the category, with TWS earbuds alone contributing $14.1 billion. The study notes that adding Auracast and LE Audio raises bill-of-materials cost by $0.40 to $0.90 per unit while unlocking an estimated $4.8 billion of incremental revenue by 2030.
